model_annotations.Bulgarian: The chart is a line graph titled "Massive Activation of baseline" with the horizontal axis labeled "Layer" ranging from 0 to 23 in increments of 5, and the vertical axis labeled "Max Activation Value" ranging from 0 to 2,000 in increments of 200. There are four lines representing different data sets, each with distinct colors: blue dashed, orange dotted, green dashed, and red solid. The blue dashed line remains at the lowest values near 0 across most layers, the orange dotted line shows a sharp increase at layer 5, peaks around layer 15, and then a sharp decline at the end. The green dashed line is flat near 0 until layer 5, then sharply increases to around 1,200, levels off until around layer 15, and then drops back to near 0. The red solid line starts at around 1,000, gradually increases to nearly 2,000 around layer 5, remains steady until just before layer 20, then drops sharply to near 1,000 and rises again towards the end of the graph. There are no markers on the lines except for the legend indicating the data set names. The legend is in the top left corner of the graph, with each line color corresponding to its data set name.
model_annotations.English: This plot titled "Massive Activation of baseline" is a line plot with two axes. The x-axis is labeled "Layer" and represents different layers in a neural network; it spans from 0 to 25, with intervals marked at 5 and 10. The y-axis is labeled "Max Activation Value" and shows how activation values vary across the different layers, with values ranging from 0 to 1600. There are four lines represented in different colors and styles, each corresponding to a different dataset or measurement within the neural network. The blue dashed line labeled "attn_output" starts near 0, rises sharply to approximately 200 at layer 5, maintains a plateau around 200 up to layer 15, and then rises to nearly 1600 at layer 25. The orange dotted line labeled "attn_residual" closely follows the pattern of the blue line, starting and ending at similar values. The green dashed line labeled "ffn_output" has a different behavior and starts at approximately 200, remains relatively stable across most layers, then rises to about 1600 at layer 25. Lastly, the red solid line labeled "ffn_residual" appears to start at around 0, immediately rises to 1600 at layer 5, slightly declines to 1400 at layer 15, and then increases back to 1600 by layer 25. The exact value of the maximum activation value is not provided, but the plot indicates trends in the activation values across the neural network layers for each dataset or measurement represented.
model_annotations.German: Das Diagramm, genannt "Massive Activation of baseline", zeigt eine Reihe von vier verschiedenen Linien, die verschiedene Maximal Activation Values miteinander vergleichen. Dies wird während verschiedenen Layer gemessen, die als x-Achse dargestellt werden. Die x-Achse ist auf die Layer, ohne eigentliche Beschriftungen für Intervalle, bescheinigt Markgrößen und hat numerische Intervalle, die jede Layer überlappt und um zwei Stellen erweitert, um 5 beginnen und 21 einzueinanderschieben. Die y-Achse, die vertikal angeordnet ist, repräsentiert die Maximal Activation Value und ist ebenfalls in nummerische Intervalle überlauft, die zwischen 0 und 1600 zueinander abgewinkelt sind, um 200-Meter-Markierungen zu zeigen. Die vier Linien in dem Diagramm sind derweil auf verschiedenen Linien dargestellt, wobei die Linien zyklisch rot (ffn_output), grün (ffn_residual), böse gerillt blau (attn_output) und gewissem Muster auf über den Rahmen gestrichen (attn_residual) erscheinen. Die Linien teilen sich an verschiedenen Stellen während der Layer zu kleineren Zahlen nach unten aufgrund ihrer eigenen Interzeptionen, und einige bestimmern die Endpunkte der anderen übermäßig an den oberen und unteren Randnarrativbauten, ebenso überloppend einige.
